summary: Iteration 350 - Two Bug Fixes Verified. All 16 tests PASSED. BUG 1: availability_only=true status filter now correctly returns only confirmed/pending_approval bookings (aligned with availability_snapshot). bug1_availability_only_status_filter.description: availability_only=true now only returns bookings with status in (confirmed, pending_approval). Verified: (1) only allowed statuses returned, (2) cancelled/no_show/completed excluded, (3) privacy-safe stubs format, (4) consistency with availability_snapshot endpoint.

bug2_aggregate_pdf_fix.description: GET /api/resource-bookings/invoices/aggregate.pdf now returns 200 with valid PDF (%PDF-1.4 magic). Verified with various filters (cost_center, account) and consistency with JSON endpoint.

regression_booking_endpoints.description: All existing booking endpoints still work: list_bookings (with/without filters), availability_snapshot, single booking invoice.pdf, catering aggregate.pdf.

code_review.routes/resources/bookings/crud.py: Lines 73-81: Added status filter when availability_only=True to align with availability_snapshot. Filter: {"$in": ["confirmed", "pending_approval"]}. This ensures the 'Frei bis HH:MM' badge matches the slot grid.
code_review.services/booking_aggregator.py: NEW file (181 LoC). Extracted compute_booking_invoice_aggregate() from invoices.py. Both JSON and PDF endpoints now call this shared service, fixing the Depends() argument shifting bug.
code_review.routes/resources/invoices.py: Lines 400-432 (aggregate_booking_invoice) and 435-477 (aggregate_booking_invoice_pdf) now both call services.booking_aggregator.compute_booking_invoice_aggregate instead of the PDF endpoint calling the JSON handler directly.
code_review.frontend/QuickBookSlotPicker.js: Line 91-96: Added defensive frontend filter to only render bookings with status 'confirmed' or 'pending_approval' as blocked slots. Aligns with backend fix.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG 1 fix is correct: availability_only=true now uses same status filter as availability_snapshot
BUG 2 fix is correct: extracting to service module avoids Depends() argument shifting
Frontend defensive filter in QuickBookSlotPicker.js is a good safety net
Both fixes are minimal and targeted - no unnecessary changes
